units.source_text: 即使说“深”，尚且很不可靠，何况说“水面浅”呢！

en.t: Even saying it is deep is hardly reliable, so how much less can one say the surface of the water is shallow!
Azechi no Kimi grew still more sorrowful.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言打开边门，说道：“我实在是要你起来看看这天空。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, opened the side door and said, I truly want you to get up and look at this sky.

units.source_text: 如此美景，怎么可以不看而睡觉呢？

en.t: With scenery this beautiful, how could anyone sleep without seeing it?

units.source_text: 并不是模仿风流人物，只因近来失眠，

en.t: It is not that I am imitating some man of refined taste, but simply that lately I cannot sleep,

units.source_text: 每觉夜长难晓，思量今世之事，

en.t: and each night feels long and slow to dawn as I ponder the affairs of this life,

units.source_text: 直至后世之事，不胜哀愁之至。”

en.t: and even the affairs of the life to come, until I am overcome with sorrow.

units.source_text: 如此搪塞一下，就出去了。

en.t: After offering this excuse, he went out.

units.source_text: 他不大对女子说风趣话，

en.t: He rarely said witty things to women,

units.source_text: 然而恐是他相貌生得俊俏可爱，

en.t: yet perhaps because his features were naturally handsome and charming,

units.source_text: 女子们并不当他是无情人。

en.t: the women did not take him for a coldhearted man.

units.source_text: 偶尔听到他一句戏言的人，

en.t: Those who happened to hear even one playful remark from him

units.source_text: 觉得即使只能在他身边看看他的美貌，也是好的。

en.t: felt that even merely staying near him and gazing at his beauty would be enough.

units.source_text: 恐是因此之故，有的女子勉强找求关系，

en.t: Perhaps for this reason, some women strained to find connections,

units.source_text: 定要到三条宫邸去替出家为尼的三公主当侍女。

en.t: determined to go to the Sanjo residence and serve as attendants to the Third Princess, who had become a nun.

units.source_text: 随着各种各样的身份，发生各种各样的悲哀情节。

en.t: According to their various ranks, all sorts of sorrowful stories unfolded.
